page: OVHcloud l40s-180 is a GPU-accelerated bare-metal or virtualized instance within the Cloud GPU family, utilizing the KVM hypervisor. The server is powered by an AMD EPYC 9124 processor featuring 30 dedicated physical cores and 30 vCPUs running at a base frequency of 2.75 GHz. It is equipped with 180 GB of system memory, providing 6.0 GB of RAM per core. For acceleration, the system integrates two NVIDIA L40S GPUs based on the Ada Lovelace architecture, delivering a combined 96 GB of GDDR6 VRAM. Local storage consists of a 400 GB NVMe SSD, and network connectivity is supported by a 16 Gbps baseline bandwidth.

Performance benchmarks indicate exceptional capabilities in machine learning and parallel processing workloads. The dual NVIDIA L40S GPUs achieve top-tier performance in LLM inference speeds across small, medium, and large models for both prompt processing and text generation. CPU-bound tasks also demonstrate high efficiency, with stress-ng single-core and multi-core performance ranking in the top 25 percent. Passmark CPU tests, including extended instructions, encryption, and physics, similarly place in the top 25 percent, while memory bandwidth for large blocks and general Geekbench processing scores remain in the middle 50 percent average tier.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the l40s-180 offers a highly dense resource profile by bundling dedicated AMD EPYC compute cores with dual enterprise-grade GPUs and local NVMe storage. This configuration avoids the overhead of separate storage or accelerator attachments, making it highly resource-efficient for intensive parallel computing. The server is optimally suited for large language model inference, deep learning training, high-performance computing, multi-threaded data decompression, and advanced cryptographic operations.
description: OVHcloud l40s-180 is a dedicated GPU-accelerated server designed for intensive parallel computing and machine learning workloads. Powered by an AMD EPYC 9124 processor with 30 physical cores and 30 vCPUs at 2.75 GHz, the system features 180 GB of RAM and a 400 GB NVMe SSD. Its primary acceleration is delivered by two NVIDIA L40S GPUs with a combined 96 GB of VRAM. Benchmark data highlights top-tier performance in LLM inference for prompt processing and text generation across 135M, 7B, and 70B models. Additionally, the server ranks in the top 25 percent for multi-core CPU stress tests, cryptographic operations, and database operations. With a 16 Gbps baseline network speed, this server is highly optimized for deep learning, large-scale AI inference, and high-performance computing tasks requiring dense GPU resources.
